_readme: The framework of differences. Each dimension names one way the same clinical situation can be framed differently by a patient and by a clinician, how a turn is classified on it, how its counterfactual is produced, and which probes can measure its effect. Dimensions and their values are owner-authored data: this file, never Python. Adding a dimension or a probe is a data change plus, for a probe, one adapter; tests/test_framework_schemas.py keeps the cross-references consistent.

dimensions.name: Lexical register
dimensions.definition: Whether the situation is stated in everyday (colloquial) wording or in clinical terminology. The study's founding contrast.

dimensions.name: <a second dimension, owner-authored>
dimensions.definition: <what differs between the two framings, stated so that a human annotator and a judge would agree on the boundary>
dimensions.owner_notes: Replace or delete. Kept so the structure of a full entry is visible.

probes.name: Advice urgency tier and flags
probes.output: tier id plus flag ids per assistant turn

probes.name: Attribution graph and clinical feature mass

requires_levels.text_io: Any model reachable as text in, text out: every API and every product UI. The behavioural layer.
requires_levels.logits: Next-token probabilities: open weights run locally, or an API that returns logprobs.
requires_levels.activations: Forward-pass internals: open weights run locally.
requires_levels.hosted_graph: A hosted attribution-graph service with a transcoder set for the model.
